Based on my earlier unconfirmed interpretation of the screenshot, "Friday" refers to a proposed day for reviewing a draft together. However, that interpretation had no specific date or time zone attached, so it can't tell you exactly which Friday is meant.

To pin it down, you'd want to check the original message for: (1) the actual calendar date, (2) any time and time zone, and (3) whether the sender proposed Friday or asked you to pick the day. Without that reviewed detail, treat "Friday" as a tentative suggestion rather than a confirmed appointment. If you can share the original screenshot or message text again, I can help you extract the exact date and time.
